name: Agentix MITRE ATT&CK Response
description: Automated SOAR playbook: Wazuh alert → Cortex enrichment → TheHive case creation → Wazuh active response. Covers T1003.008 (Credential Dumping) and T1059.004 (Reverse Shell).

actions.name: Wazuh Webhook Receiver
actions.label: trigger_webhook
actions.description: Receives Wazuh alert JSON via HTTP webhook. Wazuh integration block in ossec.conf posts here.

actions.name: Parse Wazuh Alert
actions.label: parse_alert
actions.description: Extracts rule_id, description, agent_id, agent_ip, and MITRE technique from the incoming Wazuh alert.

parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
import json
alert = json.loads("$exec")
rule_id = alert.get('rule', {}).get('id', 'unknown')
rule_desc = alert.get('rule', {}).get('description', 'No description')
mitre_ids = alert.get('rule', {}).get('mitre', {}).get('id', [])
mitre_tactic = alert.get('rule', {}).get('mitre', {}).get('tactic', [])
agent_id = alert.get('agent', {}).get('id', '000')
agent_ip = alert.get('agent', {}).get('ip', alert.get('data', {}).get('srcip', ''))
agent_name = alert.get('agent', {}).get('name', 'unknown')
timestamp = alert.get('timestamp', '')
result = {
    'rule_id': rule_id,
    'rule_desc': rule_desc,
    'mitre_ids': mitre_ids,
    'mitre_tactic': mitre_tactic,
    'agent_id': agent_id,
    'agent_ip': agent_ip,
    'agent_name': agent_name,
    'timestamp': timestamp,
    'is_credential_dump': '100002' in str(rule_id) or 'T1003' in str(mitre_ids),
    'is_reverse_shell': '100003' in str(rule_id) or 'T1059' in str(mitre_ids)
}
print(json.dumps(result))

actions.name: Cortex IP Reputation Check
actions.label: cortex_ip_enrichment
actions.description: Calls Cortex API to analyze the agent's source IP using VirusTotal_GetReport_3_1 analyzer.

actions.name: Create TheHive Case
actions.label: create_thehive_case
actions.description: Creates an incident case in TheHive with MITRE ATT&CK tags and Cortex job reference.

parameters.name: body
parameters.value:
{"title": "[AGENTIX-SIM] $step_1_parse_alert.rule_desc", "description": "**MITRE ATT&CK Simulation Alert**

- **Rule ID:** $step_1_parse_alert.rule_id
- **Description:** $step_1_parse_alert.rule_desc
- **Agent:** $step_1_parse_alert.agent_name ($step_1_parse_alert.agent_id)
- **Agent IP:** $step_1_parse_alert.agent_ip
- **Timestamp:** $step_1_parse_alert.timestamp
- **Cortex Job:** $step_2_cortex_enrichment.id

This case was created automatically by Agentix Shuffle SOAR playbook.", "severity": 3, "tlp": 2, "pap": 2, "tags": ["mitre", "agentix-sim", "wazuh", "automated", "$step_1_parse_alert.mitre_ids"]}

actions.name: Wazuh Auth Token
actions.label: wazuh_get_token
actions.description: Authenticates to Wazuh API to obtain a JWT token for active response commands.

actions.name: Isolate Endpoint via Active Response
actions.label: isolate_endpoint
actions.description: Sends host-deny active response command to Wazuh to isolate the compromised endpoint.

actions.name: Update TheHive Case with Response
actions.label: update_thehive_case
actions.description: Adds a task log to TheHive case documenting the active response action taken.

parameters.name: body
parameters.value: {"title": "Active Response Executed", "description": "Wazuh host-deny active response sent to agent $step_1_parse_alert.agent_id ($step_1_parse_alert.agent_name). Response: $step_5_isolate_endpoint.data.affected_items", "status": "Completed", "group": "Containment"}
